caseStudy.problem: Local Python transcript and audio analysis with dependency-free core commands and synthetic tests.
caseStudy.role: Personal project: implementation, integration and testing.
architecture: A standard-library CLI computes transcript statistics and WAV measurements. FFmpeg conversion and optional pitch analysis extend the core without uploading source recordings.
validation: Public source includes documented focused test commands; see the repository validation notes for current results.
limitations: Research tools, not clinical speech assessment. Real recordings, transcripts and derived personal outputs are deliberately excluded. FFmpeg is needed for formats other than supported WAV input.
